# Lunar Navigator

> An educational NASA Space Apps 2026 prototype for comparing lunar locations and arrival dates, with documented terrain horizons and astronomical positions. Not an operational landing or communications service.

## Read the project

- [Plain-text summary](https://lunar-navigator-2026.pages.dev/summary.txt): scope, workflows, methods and limitations.
- [HTML summary](https://lunar-navigator-2026.pages.dev/summary.html): human-readable project overview.
- [Dataset manifest](https://lunar-navigator-2026.pages.dev/data/manifest.json): conventions, coverage, products and checksums.
- [Validation](https://lunar-navigator-2026.pages.dev/data/validation.json): executed scientific checks and their caveats.
- [Credits](https://lunar-navigator-2026.pages.dev/credits.json): third-party software inventory.
- [AI assistance](https://lunar-navigator-2026.pages.dev/ai-use.json): factual assistance disclosure and unresolved interpretation of earlier ideation.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/Andre1B/lunar-navigator-spaceapps-2026): original Apache-2.0 code and third-party notices.

Original code licensing does not relicense scientific datasets, images, official brand assets or third-party packages. Cite their original sources and preserve their applicable notices. Free Mode configurations are artificial and cannot support real mission recommendations. A visibility fraction is not a radio link or power budget. No NASA endorsement is claimed.
